notes.title: Destructivator 2 is OUT NOW!!
notes.notes:
Are you ready to protect earth from an evil alien force?

Great, then get your best pants on and let's go!

Destructivator 2 is a retro-style platform shooter.  Battle soldiers, small robots, big robots, medium size robots, the lot.  Avoid vicious traps and don't forget to take out those pesky spy bots!

Your mission is simple - destroy everything!  

Good luck out there!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
A small update to the the demo, you can now select from a skill level:

[list]
[*] Easy
[*] Normal
[*] Hard
[/list]

If you found the original a little too intense, give it a go on normal or easy mode!
